    p.category,
    COALESCE(SUM(oi.unit_price_minor * oi.quantity), 0) / 100.0 AS amount_dollars

GROUP BY p.category;

       COUNT(*) AS orders_delivered
FROM orders

ORDER BY month;

    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS canceled_percentage

GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY c.country;

WITH product_totals AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.category, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units
    FROM products AS p
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY p.id, p.category, p.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT category, name, units,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY units DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM product_totals
)
SELECT category, name AS product_name, units
FROM ranked
WHERE sales_rank = 1
ORDER BY category, product_name;

WITH order_values AS (
    SELECT o.id,
           COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor), 0) AS merchandise_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
    GROUP BY o.id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_above_average
FROM order_values
WHERE merchandise_minor > (SELECT AVG(merchandise_minor) FROM order_values);

SELECT
    o.id AS order_id,
    (COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) + o.shipping_minor) / 100.0 AS total_dollars
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY o.id, o.shipping_minor
ORDER BY total_dollars DESC, order_id ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT p.id,
           p.category,
           p.name AS product_name,
           SUM(oi.quantity) AS units
    FROM products AS p
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY p.id, p.category, p.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT category,
           product_name,
           units,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY units DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM product_sales
)
SELECT category, product_name, units
FROM ranked
WHERE sales_rank = 1
ORDER BY category, product_name;

           COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) AS merchandise_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    GROUP BY o.id
)

FROM order_values

SELECT
    o.id AS order_id,
    (COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) + o.shipping_minor) / 100.0
        AS total_dollars
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY o.id, o.shipping_minor
ORDER BY total_dollars DESC, o.id ASC
LIMIT 3;

GROUP BY c.id, c.name;

    c.segment,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) / 100.0 AS revenue_dollars
FROM customers AS c

WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY c.segment;

    c.country AS country_code,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
          / COUNT(*), 2) AS cancelled_percentage
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY c.country;

WITH product_totals AS (
    SELECT p.category,
           p.id AS product_id,
           p.name AS product_name,
           SUM(oi.quantity) AS units
    FROM products AS p
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY p.category, p.id, p.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT category,
           product_id,
           product_name,
           units,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY category ORDER BY units DESC
           ) AS sales_rank
    FROM product_totals
)
SELECT category, product_name, units
FROM ranked
WHERE sales_rank = 1
ORDER BY category, product_name, product_id;

    SELECT o.id,
           COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor), 0) AS merchandise_value
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
    GROUP BY o.id
)

FROM order_values
WHERE merchandise_value > (SELECT AVG(merchandise_value) FROM order_values);

    (COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) + o.shipping_minor) / 100.0 AS total_dollars
FROM orders AS o

ORDER BY total_dollars DESC, o.id ASC
